system.description:
You can use a ranged weapon as a melee weapon without taking a penalty on your attack roll. The weapon is otherwise treated as a Club in all respects.

If you are using a Rifle with a mounted Bayonet or Vibrobayonet, you may wield that weapon as a Double Weapon. The Bayonet or Vibrobayonet end is treated normally, and the other end is treated as a Club.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook
